Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goals: reduce inference costs on batch jobs, get sub-300ms tail latency for customer-facing flows, and centralize model routing across regions.
- Current infra: Kubernetes + spot GPUs for training, serving done by a mix of managed endpoints and in-house L0.
- Key constraints: must meet SOC2 evidence and be able to deploy into their VPC for PII flows.

Next step: technical deep dive / demo with our SE to walk architecture, quantization options, and autoscaling profiles. Neha (cc) will lead the deep dive.

Proposed times (all PT):
- Wed Mar 11, 10:00–11:00 AM
- Thu Mar 12, 2:00–3:00 PM

I attached a 1-pg agenda to help scope the session. Please let me know which slot works and who from your engineering team will join. If none of the above work, tell me a couple windows and I’ll align Neha.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you a tailored plan.
